info.name: Domain API 🍔🍔🍔
info.description:
- Endpoint: `GET /v26/api.{json|xml|csv|xlsx}` - technology and metadata for a domain.
- Example: `https://api.builtwith.com/v26/api.json?KEY=YOUR_KEY&LOOKUP=example.com`
Domain API v26 includes `Meta.company_reg`, an array of company registrations with string `type` and `number` fields, for example `"company_reg": [{"type":"ABN","number":"23232322"}]`. The array is empty when no registrations are available, including with `NOMETA=yes`. Registration numbers are strings to preserve leading zeros. Company registration metadata is available in JSON and XML.

- Credits: 1 per domain looked up.
- `v26` includes `Result.SpendHistory` (historic monthly spend as `{D, S}` pairs), per-result `SalesRevenue`, and per-technology `Id`; earlier Domain API versions remain available with their existing response formats and omit `confidence`.

### Parameters
- `KEY` (required) - your API key.
- `LOOKUP` (required) - root domain to look up. Multi-lookup: up to 16 domains as CSV, for example `cnn.com,about.com,builtwith.com`.
- `HIDETEXT` (`yes`) - hide technology description, link, tag and category fields.
- `HIDEDL` (`yes`) - hide technology description and link fields (keep tag and categories).
- `LIVEONLY` (`yes`) - only return technologies considered live.
- `TRUST` (`yes`) - include Trust data, same as an additional Trust API call; uses an additional API credit.
- `NOMETA` (`yes`) - no meta data (address, names etc.) returned; improves performance.
- `NOPII` (`yes`) - remove people names/emails. EU and California PII is automatically removed regardless.
- `NOATTR` (`yes`) - no attributes data returned; improves performance.
- `IP` (`yes`) - include IP address information when available.
- `FDRANGE` (`YYYY-MM-DD|YYYY-MM-DD`) - filter technologies by first detected date range.
- `LDRANGE` (`YYYY-MM-DD|YYYY-MM-DD`) - filter technologies by last detected date range.

### Index lookups (no LOOKUP needed)
- `GET /v26/api.json?KEY=YOUR_KEY&CATEGORIES=yes` - full technology category index (tags with sub-categories).
- `GET /v26/api.json?KEY=YOUR_KEY&VERTICALS=1` - list of valid `Vertical` values.

### Response object
Format: `Results[ Lookup, Result -> Paths[ Path -> Technologies[Technology] ], Meta, Attributes ], Errors[]`

Result-level fields:
- `Lookup` - the domain that was looked up.
- `IsDB` - `True`/`False`/`Misleading`: whether the lookup used the database or visited the site; `Misleading` means a user-generated-content site profile.
- `Result.Spend` - average monthly USD tech spend based on detected technologies.
- `Result.SalesRevenue` - estimated monthly USD sales revenue for eCommerce sites (0 for non-eCommerce).
- `Result.SpendHistory` - array of `{D, S}` (epoch-millisecond date, USD spend) across domain coverage; max 60 periods between first/last indexed.
- `Meta` - meta data object (below).
- `Attributes` - attributes object (below).
- `FirstIndexed` / `LastIndexed` - earliest/most recent index points for the entire domain.

Path fields:
- `Domain` - the root domain.
- `Url` - `dd` means path data built from multiple sub-pages (domain-only lookups).
- `SubDomain` - subdomain of the profile (e.g. `blog` + `disney.com` = blog.disney.com).
- `FirstIndexed` / `LastIndexed` - earliest/most recent index points for this path.

Technology fields:
- `Name` - name of the technology found.
- `Id` - BuiltWith technology integer identifier (v26).
- `Parent` - parent technology name (for versions etc.).
- `Description` - description of the technology.
- `Link` - link to the technology website.
- `IsPremium` - is this a paid technology: `yes`, `no`, or `maybe`.
- `Tag` - base category (see the `CATEGORIES=yes` index).
- `Categories` - array of sub-categories for the tag.
- `FirstDetected` / `LastDetected` - dates the technology was first/last detected.
- `confidence` - lowercase numeric field in every v26 technology record, from 0 to 1 inclusive. JSON uses `"confidence": 0.75`; XML uses `<confidence>0.75</confidence>`. CSV/XLSX include a `confidence` column. See the scoring rules below.

### Technology confidence scoring

Records whose `Tag` is `operations` always have `confidence` of 0.5, overriding all scam/gambling, parked and one-off rules. Tag matching is case-insensitive.

All other technologies start at 1. Apply these rules in order:

1. If any active technology's `Name` ends with ` scam` or equals `Gambling Content`, set scores to 0 except technologies whose names end with ` scam` or equal `Gambling Content` and records whose `Tag` is `hosting`, `mx`, `parked`, `registrar`, `ns` or `Server`.
2. If any active technology's `Tag` is `parked`, subtract 0.5 from every score except records tagged `parked` or `hosting`.
3. If a technology's `FirstDetected` equals its `LastDetected`, subtract 0.25 from that record. This one-off deduction also applies to scam, Gambling Content, parked, hosting and other server records.
4. Clamp the final score to a minimum of 0. Deductions combine; the resulting score is always between 0 and 1.

Name suffix and tag comparisons are case-insensitive. The leading space in ` scam` is required; `Gambling Content` must match the whole name. Active means `LastDetected` is strictly later than the current full database update cutoff, matching `LIVEONLY`. Historical scam, Gambling Content or parked detections do not trigger domain-wide deductions.

Scam/gambling and parked signals apply across all paths within each lookup domain, independently for each domain in a batch. Signals are captured before `FDRANGE`, `LDRANGE` or `LIVEONLY` can remove detections. `HIDETEXT` and `HIDEDL` do not change the scores or remove `confidence`.

Examples:

| Technology and domain signals | confidence |
| --- | --- |
| Any operations-tagged record, regardless of detection dates or active scam/parked signals | 0.5 |
| Ordinary repeated detection, no active scam or parked signal | 1 |
| Ordinary one-off detection, no active scam or parked signal | 0.75 |
| Ordinary repeated detection on an actively parked domain | 0.5 |
| Ordinary one-off detection on an actively parked domain | 0.25 |
| Ordinary detection on a domain with an active scam or Gambling Content technology | 0 |
| Repeated Gambling Content detection, without an active parked signal | 1 |
| Hosting one-off detection, with both active scam and parked signals | 0.75 |
| Repeated scam technology on an actively parked domain, with a tag other than parked or hosting | 0.5 |

### Metadata and attributes


Meta fields:
- `ARank` - Page Rank, 1 to 100,000,000.
- `QRank` - Tranco traffic rank, 1 to 1,000,000.
- `Majestic` - Majestic rank, 1 to 1,000,000.
- `Umbrella` - Umbrella global router traffic rank, 1 to 1,000,000.
- `CompanyName`, `City`, `Postcode`, `State`, `Country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), `Vertical` (see `VERTICALS=1` index), `PrimaryBusiness` (primary business classification name, or blank).
- `Telephones[]`, `Emails[]`, `Social[]` - contact details and social presence.
- `Names[]` - people: `Name`, `Level` (job title), `Email`. Removed when `NOPII=yes`.

Attributes fields:
- `MJRank`, `MJTLDRank` - Majestic rank and top-level-domain rank.
- `RefSN`, `RefIP` - referring subnet and IP counts.
- `Sitemap` - sitemap link count.
- `GTMTags`, `QubitTags`, `TealiumTags`, `AdobeTags` - tag manager tag counts.
- `CDimensions`, `CGoals`, `CMetrics` - custom analytics dimension/goal/metric counts.
- `Followers` - brand social followers, grouped (1000 = 1000+ but under 2000).
- `ProductCount` - SKU product count.
- `Employees` - employee count estimate.
- `PageRank`, `BWRank`, `Tranco`, `BWS` - rank attribute values.
- `Revenue` - revenue attribute value.
- `EcommerceCategory` - eCommerce category id.
- `AIMaturity`, `AIOpenness`, `AIReadiness`, `AIVisibility` - AI scores.
- `TTFB` - time to first byte.
- `SourceBytes` - source byte count.

Sample response (fields abridged; full sample at `https://api.builtwith.com/samples/domain_api_v22.json`; v26 uses the same shape plus `Meta.company_reg`, `SpendHistory`, `SalesRevenue`, and technology `Id` and `confidence`):
```json
{
  "Results": [
    {
      "Lookup": "example.com",
      "Result": {
        "Paths": [
          {
            "Technologies": [
              {
                "Name": "nginx",
                "Id": 1515864597,
                "confidence": 1,
                "Tag": "Web Server",
                "Categories": ["Web Server"],
                "FirstDetected": 1700000000000,
                "LastDetected": 1760000000000,
                "IsPremium": "No"
              }
            ]
          }
        ],
        "Spend": 11390,
        "SalesRevenue": 0,
        "SpendHistory": [{ "D": 1140042000000, "S": 100 }]
      },
      "Meta": {
        "PrimaryBusiness": "Travel & Tourism",
        "company_reg": [{"type": "ABN", "number": "23232322"}],
        "CompanyName": "Example Inc",
        "Country": "US"
      }
    }
  ],
  "Errors": []
}
```

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.
